Garage Gym Heater

For most garage gyms, an electric heater is the safest pick: a 1,500-watt plug-in for a small, insulated space, or a hardwired 240-volt unit for a two-car garage. Avoid unvented propane or kerosene heaters indoors; the US Department of Energy says unvented combustion heaters are not recommended inside the home because of carbon monoxide. Insulating the garage door often matters more than the heater.
